verifier_mainline_integration_status: not integrated into runtime, admission, Gate4, Gate5, Route C, or scheduler paths
decisive_caveats: The verifier is a provenance-shape prefilter only.
It does not adjudicate metric degeneracy.
It does not prove the declared strongest fair baseline is actually the strongest.
It does not perform real replay recomputation or source re-hashing by itself.
It must not be treated as an admission gate.

claim_ceiling: Verifier status readback only; no Gate admission, no baseline-immunity, no mechanism validity, and no candidate success.
